# Third-party downloads

Every third-party file is listed in `third_party/manifest.ron`, and the bake fails on
any file that is not. This page says what has been fetched, what is waiting for the
owner's approval, and what a session could not reach.

## Fetched

Both typefaces are named, with their addresses, in
`full-game/docs/brief/1.1b-asset-catalog.md`. They were fetched from those addresses on
2026-11-10 and are in the manifest.

| File | From | License |
|---|---|---|
| `fonts/tiny5/Tiny5.ttf` and `OFL.txt` | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/tiny5 | OFL-1.1 |
| `fonts/imfellenglish/IMFeENrm28P.ttf` and `OFL.txt` | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/imfellenglish | OFL-1.1 |

## Waiting for the owner's approval

Phases S01 and S02 need material maps: albedo, normal, and roughness, at 1K, as the
bake's input for shading and for per-cell glyph data. Both sites are CC0 and are in the
approved catalog. The exact assets are chosen in S01-T02 from each site's own pages,
one asset to a material, and the list is put here for approval before anything is
fetched. Until then the yard is built on materials generated by code, which the rules
allow and which the textures replace without any change to the renderer.

| Material | Site | For |
|---|---|---|
| Rough stone masonry | ambientCG or Poly Haven | The yard wall, the ossuary |
| Weathered timber planks | ambientCG or Poly Haven | The door, the bench, the sign |
| Woven cloth | ambientCG or Poly Haven | The hanging sign's banner |
| Dark wrought iron | ambientCG or Poly Haven | Hinges, the lantern |
| Packed earth with stones | ambientCG or Poly Haven | The yard's ground |
| Grass and soil | ambientCG or Poly Haven | The hill and the fields (S02) |
| Bare rock | ambientCG or Poly Haven | Outcrops (S02) |
| Bark | ambientCG or Poly Haven | Trees (S02) |
| Thatch and roof tile | ambientCG or Poly Haven | Roofs (S02, S06) |

## What this machine can reach

| Site | Result |
|---|---|
| `raw.githubusercontent.com` (fonts) | Reached |
| `polyhaven.com` | Reached |
| `ambientcg.com` | Reached |
| `quaternius.com` | Reached |
| `kenney.nl` | Refused (403). Files from Kenney will need the owner to add them to `third_party/inbox/` |
| `kaylousberg.itch.io`, `freesound.org`, `sonniss.com`, `versilian-studios.com` | Not yet tried. Each needs a browser, an account, or a checkout |
